name: fabricator
description: Fabricator helps create, maintain, publish, and review reliable Codex plugins and plugin-adjacent projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create, maintain, and publish Codex plugins.
interface.longDescription: Fabricator helps turn plugin ideas, existing Codex plugins, and plugin-adjacent project surfaces into clear, testable workflows. Craft handles local creation and maintenance. Publish handles public release preparation, package evidence, and runtime publication checks. Requested chat reviews are handled as manual project work instead of recurring background monitoring.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Fabricator for Codex plugin creation, publishing, review, and runtime updates.
